Description text alone ('Weather Events') gives no specific hazard keyword. FEMA's major disaster declaration for this event (FEMA-4420-DR-NE, issued March 21 2019) is titled 'Severe Winter Storm, Straight-Line Winds, and Flooding' for the incident period beginning March 9 2019 - this is the historic Nebraska bomb-cyclone flood. Classified winter as the lead hazard per FEMA's own title; flooding was the larger damage driver and could equally be argued as primary.
